m: 1. राघ् (cf. √ लाघ्) cl. 1. Ā. राघते (pf. रराघे &c.; Caus. राघयति aor. अरराघत् Gr.), to be able or competent, Dhātup. iv, 38.
2. राघ् m. (nom. राक्) an able or efficient person, MW.
a: राघ् — {c1c} A. To be able, to suffice.
राघ् — m. An able or efficient person.

m: राघव m. (fr. रघु) a descendant of Raghu patr. of Aja, of Daśa-ratha, and (esp.) of Rāma-candra (du. राघवौ = Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa), R.; Ragh. &c.
N. of various authors and others (also with आचार्य, भट्ट, पञ्चानन-भट्टाचार्य, चक्रवर्तिन्, राय &c.), Cat.
of a serpent-demon, L.
the seas, ocean, L.
a species of large fish, L.
a: राघवः — [रघोर्गोत्रापत्यं अण्] 1 A descendant of Raghu, especially Rāma. --2 A kind of large fish; Bv. 1. 55. --3 Sea, ocean.
